decisions.reason: Check Point report of PHP2Shell exploitation against Check Point Gateway appliances with wiper deployment in two waves; same CVE-2026-109618/109619/123039 cluster already covered as PHP2Shell firewall rooting. Adds the Check Point wave detail to the canonical PHP2Shell story.

CVE-2026-109618.evidence: Attackers exploited PHP2Shell for initial access on Check Point Gateway appliances, then deployed a wiper; two waves from Oct 30 (Israeli targets) and Nov 2 (multiple countries).

CVE-2026-109619.evidence: PHP2Shell is tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619; the Check Point campaign used it for initial access and webshell placement.

CVE-2026-123039.evidence: Attackers chained CVE-2026-123039, a local privilege escalation in the DynamicCLI process, to gain root on the gateway after PHP2Shell initial access.

decisions.reason: Same N-able N-central exploitation campaign: the 4EverAble2Shell zero-day chain (CVE-2026-90436 plus an unspecified N-central hole with Legacy API enabled) released by Sean Bales after N-able's fixes, exploited within hours. Belongs to the existing N-central story.

CVE-2026-90436.evidence: Sean Bales published a working chain on GitHub combining the Apache Axis RCE (CVE-2026-90436, CVSS 9.8) with an unspecified N-central hole; threat actors began exploiting it hours later to gain root RCE on N-central servers.

decisions.story_title: CERT Polska reports 8 vulnerabilities in Edito CMS (CVE-2026-59074 through CVE-2026-59081)
decisions.reason: National CERT advisory covering a distinct CMS with a full CVE range; real vulnerability advisory with substance, not duplicated elsewhere in the store.

decisions.story_title: Beast ransomware sample gives affiliates a GUI console and wipes recovery before encrypting
decisions.reason: New malware analysis detail (AttackIQ, Oct 23 2026): interactive console, settings override, shadow copy and backup service destruction, with Symantec/Carbon Black attribution to developer Hyadina. Distinct ransomware tooling, not covered by an existing story.
